summary: Create coherent variation from compatible modules, role-driven proportions, local story state and deterministic choices instead of scattering identical clones or random decoration.
objective: Two seeded layouts remain recognizably related, navigable and functionally legible while repeated modules vary by role and retain stable identities across reload and reset.
applies_when: A modular environment or prop family needs many variants without losing authored composition, route clarity or state persistence.
intent_signals: vary modular rooms without obvious clones
keep selected modules stable after reload
example_prompts: Generate a compact market lane and a service courtyard from the same fictional kit with different role and wear distributions.
Build two research outpost layouts whose modules share interfaces but not identical silhouettes or prop scatter.
not_for: Unconstrained procedural generation presented as guaranteed playable or accessible.
Historical settlement patterns or cultural motifs without separate research.

principles: Lock connection and clearance rules before varying silhouette, finish and story detail. Variation cannot repair incompatible sockets or blocked routes.
Vary by role and neighborhood: entrance, service, gathering, storage and landmark modules need different proportions and prop density.
Use structured families and weighted choices, not independent randomness on every attribute. Reserve distinctive variants for landmarks and state changes.
Separate stable semantic identity from visual variant. A saved selection or annotation should resolve even when a permitted visual choice changes.
A seed reproduces choices; it does not prove the result is composed well. Keep authored constraints and inspection checks around generation.
implementation: In Blender, author a kit with named sockets, pivots, clearance envelopes, role tags, compatible variant families and at least one plain fallback for each required role.
Build two authored reference compositions, such as a market lane and service courtyard, to prove the kit supports different arrangements before adding runtime variation.

Export explicit module, socket, role, variant-family and stable-instance identifiers. Convert source-only Geometry Nodes or collection logic into realized geometry, retained metadata or an application reconstruction contract as chosen.

In Three.js, derive variation from a versioned seed plus semantic instance ID, apply choices in a stable order and keep route-critical dimensions and interaction anchors outside cosmetic randomization.

Distribute wear, signage, clutter and active states from local story conditions: frequently used entrances differ from sealed storage; repaired modules reuse grammar but receive a traceable exception.
Persist the seed, generator version and any user-authored overrides. Reset restores the declared layout and variants rather than drawing a new scene accidentally.
observable_checks: Generate the same seed twice: module identities, socket connections, required clearances and variants match exactly.
Generate two approved seeds: both preserve entrances and routes, while landmark silhouette, neighborhood rhythm and story traces differ visibly.
Select and annotate a stable module, reload, and resolve the same semantic instance without depending on its display name or traversal order.
Inspect repeated modules side by side; variation follows their role or local story rather than arbitrary per-axis scale and noise.
Substitute each nonessential variant with its fallback; connection, interaction and reset contracts still hold.
Change generator version deliberately and report migration or invalidated overrides instead of silently reshuffling a saved scene.

creative_affordances: Allow hand-authored landmark overrides on top of deterministic neighborhoods while keeping them in the saved state contract.
Use color, material age, roofline, attachments or occupancy as separate variation axes, choosing only those that serve the brief.
known_limits: Authored variation guidance; no generator, navigation evaluation, runtime layout or usability result was observed.
A reproducible seed establishes repeatability only, not quality, accessibility or absence of collisions.
